items.stem: Why might an inner_join unintentionally drop data compared with a left_join?

options.text: inner_join keeps only matching keys, discarding unmatched left-side rows
options.rationale: Unmatched rows are removed by an inner join but kept by a left join.
Column order is not the issue.

options.text: left_join cannot match on multiple keys
options.rationale: Both can join on multiple keys.
